title: Let the Mind Conceive, Let the Hand Achieve: Following Multimodal Instructions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: 让思维构想，让双手实现：遵循多模态指令完成长期机器人操作任务

paragraphs.en: Orchestra 是一种智能体框架，能将多模态指令分解为有序子任务，实现长期机器人操作任务。 A robot following a multi-step instruction needs to act on the right objects in the right order, even as the scene changes. It must also maintain awareness of task progress and determine when to advance. To address these challenges, we introduce Orchestra, an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation. Orchestra decomposes a complete multimodal instruction into ordered subtasks, tracks completed steps, and updates the locations of relevant objects and destinations during execution. It maintains a shared context containing the active subtask, spatial grounding, and recent observations. An action policy uses this context to generate actions, while a separately trained progress evaluator estimates when to advance to the next subtask. To evaluate whether robots trained on atomic instructions and short trajectories can execute longer subtask sequences, we introduce a benchmark named RMBench-Compose. Orchestra achieves a mean success rate of $68.22\%$ across nine RMBench tasks, outperforming Mem-0 by $26.22$ percentage points. On RMBench-Compose, it achieves an Average Success Length (ASL) of $7.35$ subtasks, $2.46$ times that of HarnessVLA. Across four real-world multi-step tasks, it improves mean ASL by $25.0\%$ over Orchestra using the base $π_{0.5}$ policy. These results show that Orchestra helps robots carry out longer sequences of subtasks while preserving the requested subtask order and acting on the specified objects. Our code and project page are available at https://youpengwen.github.io/Orchestra.
paragraphs.zh: Orchestra 是一种智能体框架，能够将多模态指令分解为有序的子任务，从而实现长期的机器人操作任务。遵循多步骤指令的机器人需要在场景变化的情况下，以正确的顺序对正确的物体进行操作。 它还必须持续了解任务进展，并决定何时推进到下一步。 为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 Orchestra——一种智能体工具包，它将任务规划与执行管理从动作生成中分离出来。 Orchestra 将完整的多模态指令分解为有序的子任务，跟踪已完成步骤，并在执行过程中更新相关物体和目的地位置。 它维护一个共享上下文，其中包含当前活跃的子任务、空间定位信息以及最近的观察结果。 动作策略利用该上下文生成动作，而一个独立训练的进展评估器则判断何时推进到下一个子任务。 为了评估在原子指令和短轨迹上训练的机器人能否执行更长的子任务序列，我们引入了一个名为 RMBench-Compose 的基准测试。 Orchestra 在九个 RMBench 任务中实现了 $68.22\%$ 的平均成功率，比 Mem-0 高出 $26.22$ 个百分点。 在 RMBench-Compose 上，其平均成功子任务长度（ASL）为 $7.35$，是 HarnessVLA 的 $2.46$ 倍。 在四个真实世界的多步骤任务中，与使用基础 $π_{0.5}$ 策略的 Orchestra 相比，其平均 ASL 提升了 $25.0\%$。 这些结果表明，Orchestra 有助于机器人执行更长的子任务序列，同时保持所要求的子任务顺序并对指定的物体进行操作。 我们的代码和项目页面可在 https://youpengwen.github.io/Orchestra 获取。
